definitions.explanation: A dramatic change in appearance, form, or nature. Used for both literal transformations (in fiction, mythology) and figurative ones (personal reinvention, dramatic makeovers).

examples.japanese: ⟦ヒーロー→ヒーロー：11262_hiiroo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{変身|へんしん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦ダイエット→ダイエット：17678_daietto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{別人|べつじん}→別人：11877_betsujin⟧⟦のように→のように：30291_noyouni⟧{変身|へんしん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Through dieting, she transformed as if into a different person.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧な⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{観光地|かんこうち}→観光地：14163_kankouchi⟧⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧{変身|へんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げた→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧。
examples.english: That quiet town underwent a great transformation as a tourist destination.

notes:
USAGE:
Iconically associated with Japanese tokusatsu (live-action superhero) shows where heroes shout "{変身|へんしん}!" to trigger their transformation. Beyond fiction, used for dramatic real-life makeovers (fashion, weight loss) and figurative transformations of places or organizations.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {変身|へんしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to transform
- {変身|へんしん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧: to undergo a transformation
- ⟦{華麗|かれい}→華麗：09199_karei⟧な{変身|へんしん}: splendid transformation
- ⟦{劇的|げきてき}→劇的：06830_gekiteki⟧な{変身|へんしん}: dramatic transformation
- {変身|へんしん}⟦ポーズ→ポーズ：11268_poozu⟧: transformation pose (tokusatsu)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{変身|へんしん} implies a dramatic, visible change in form or appearance. ⟦{変装|へんそう}→変装：12098_hensou⟧ (disguise) is about altering appearance to hide identity. ⟦{変容|へんよう}→変容：12115_henyou⟧ (transformation) is more formal and used for gradual, abstract changes.
